X000010539.title: Sentinel Jacket
X000010539.tagline: Our iconic GORE-TEX ePE jacket for the backcountry and resort.

sections.heading: Sentinel Jacket
sections.body:
Built for the vertical aspects of big mountain skiing, the rugged, comfortable Sentinel Jacket is a freeride legend. Durable, breathable 80D 3L ePE GORE-TEX seals out the elements and has a warm backer for soft comfort. The progressive design and ergonomic patterning remove restriction, WaterTight pit zips ventilate, and the helmet-compatible StormHood adjusts for full coverage and exceptional visibility. Large pockets are secure and accessible, and a RECCO® reflector can aid search and rescue.

This product is free of intentionally added PFAS.

The new ePE membrane technology is lighter and thinner, but just as strong and durable as the materials we used before.   You may notice the face fabric “wetting out” slightly faster in products with ePE membranes, but rest assured this does not affect the waterproofing of the membrane itself. If you notice the fabric wetting out faster than you’d like, simply wash the jacket and dry it to remove the oil contamination and bring the DWR back to its full power.

X000009866.title: Alpha Jacket
X000009866.tagline: Alpine-ready durability and lightweight performance for fast, technical ascents.

sections.heading: Alpha Jacket
sections.body:
The Alpha Jacket is purposefully designed for fast, technical ascents where every gram counts, but having a reliable alpine shield is non-negotiable. Pairing GORE-TEX PRO ePE with 50D Hadron™ face fabric strikes the right balance between waterproof-breathable protection and abrasion resistance, making it ideal for daily use in rugged terrain and shifting conditions. With a harness-compatible build and precise articulation, this jacket is made to climb through any storm.

What's been updated: Updated to GORE-TEX PRO ePE, the Alpha Jacket features a new membrane that offers the highest-performing waterproof-breathable protection in an even lighter and more durable package—all while remaining free from intentionally added PFAS. A low-profile RECCO® reflector hidden in the hood brim improves your searchability in emergency situations. A new internal dump pocket makes stashing gloves easy, and the internal security pocket keeps valuables safe.

sections.heading: Alpha SV Jacket
sections.body:

The Alpha SV Jacket is built to endure relentlessly severe conditions, committing ascents, and sustained exposure in the world’s harshest alpine terrain. Constructed with burly 100D GORE-TEX PRO ePE, this shell delivers unwavering waterproof-breathable performance and confidence-inspiring protection that will keep you climbing—even when the mountain is at its worst.

A low-profile RECCO® reflector hidden in the hood brim improves your searchability in emergency situations. Internal storage options have expanded to include two new dump pockets for stashing gloves or a toque, as well as a security pocket to keep valuables safe.

X000009469.title: Norvan Jacket
X000009469.tagline: Ultralight, highly breathable GORE-TEX shell for running in the mountains. The Norvan Jacket was previously the Norvan Shell Jacket.

sections.heading: Norvan Jacket
sections.body:
An ultralight solution for running in the rain, the Norvan Jacket offers exceptional breathability while keeping you dry. The fully waterproof fabric allows sweat to escape without letting outside moisture in so you can focus solely on the trail in front of you. Run-friendly details like vents under the arms make staying on pace no sweat.

What's been updated: Updated with lighter, more durable, and PFAS-free 15D GORE-TEX ePE. Design updates include a new stowable, zippered hip pocket; large reflective branding for low-light visibility; a fully adjustable hood with a small brim; an interior flip cuff for added warmth and protection during bad weather; a new adjustable cordlock system at the hem; and a more discreet RECCO® reflector placement (in the hood).

This product is free of intentionally added PFAS.

The new ePE membrane technology is lighter and thinner, but just as strong and durable as the materials we used before.   You may notice the face fabric “wetting out” slightly faster in products with ePE membranes, but rest assured this does not affect the waterproofing of the membrane itself. If you notice the fabric wetting out faster than you’d like, simply wash the jacket and dry it to remove the oil contamination and bring the DWR back to its full power.

X000009948.title: Andessa Down Jacket
X000009948.tagline: Warm, waterproof jacket for resort skiing and snowboarding.

sections.heading: Andessa Down Jacket
sections.body:
With lofty goose down insulation and PFAS-free GORE-TEX wind and weather protection, the Andessa keeps you warm and dry when conditions get harsh. Its shorter length delivers freedom of movement and easy layering with a clean look, and the construction eliminates cold spots. An insulated adjustable hood fits over your helmet, multiple pockets offer storage, and a down-insulated collar wraps the neck for next-level warmth.

This product is free of intentionally added PFAS.

The new ePE membrane technology is lighter and thinner, but just as strong and durable as the materials we used before.   You may notice the face fabric “wetting out” slightly faster in products with ePE membranes, but rest assured this does not affect the waterproofing of the membrane itself. If you notice the fabric wetting out faster than you’d like, simply wash the jacket and dry it to remove the oil contamination and bring the DWR back to its full power.

X000009468.title: Beta Pant
X000009468.tagline: Lightweight, layerable shell pant for hiking and climbing in wet conditions.

sections.heading: Beta Pant
sections.body:
Part of what makes hikes like Tour du Mont Blanc so magical is the mystery of what’s around the bend—be it a fantastic view or sheet of rain. Luckily, the Beta Pant is here to keep you dry when you need it. The breathable, waterproof fabric allows vapor from your body to escape without letting water in. Plus, ¾-length side zips provide extra ventilation and make it easy to layer up in an unexpected storm.

What's been updated: Updated with a PFAS-free GORE-TEX ePE laminate for a lower footprint. A new low-profile bonded stretch waistband with lower profile internal waist drawcord, single thigh pocket, and ¾-length side zipper deliver improved comfort and freedom of movement. An updated lower-profile hem reinforcement gives enhanced durability.

This product is free of intentionally added PFAS.

The new ePE membrane technology is lighter and thinner, but just as strong and durable as the materials we used before.   You may notice the face fabric “wetting out” slightly faster in products with ePE membranes, but rest assured this does not affect the waterproofing of the membrane itself. If you notice the fabric wetting out faster than you’d like, simply wash the jacket and dry it to remove the oil contamination and bring the DWR back to its full power.

X000009106.title: Sentinel Bib Pant
X000009106.tagline: GORE-TEX bib for the back country and resort.

sections.heading: Sentinel Bib Pant
sections.body:
Powder days are bib days. Made for freeriders looking for the steep and deep, the Sentinel’s breathable GORE-TEX fabric has a durable 80D face, shuts out wind and snow, and is PFAS-free for lighter footprint. A brushed backer adds comfort. Thigh vents release heat on uptracks, RECCO technology can aid in search situations, a drop seat speeds pit stops, and the pockets are ample and organized. Articulated for the snow, the Sentinel gives you freedom to move on backcountry tours or days at the resort.

What's been updated: Updated with a new GORE-TEX ePE fabric with a more durable 80D recycled face, recycled C-KNIT backer, and a PFAS-free waterproof, breathable laminate.

This product is free of intentionally added PFAS.

The new ePE membrane technology is lighter and thinner, but just as strong and durable as the materials we used before.   You may notice the face fabric “wetting out” slightly faster in products with ePE membranes, but rest assured this does not affect the waterproofing of the membrane itself. If you notice the fabric wetting out faster than you’d like, simply wash the jacket and dry it to remove the oil contamination and bring the DWR back to its full power.

X000009674.title: Beta SL Jacket
X000009674.tagline: Light, packable all-mountain GORE-TEX ePE shell with an extensive feature set.

sections.heading: Beta SL Jacket
sections.body:
Made for alpine travel and mountain realities, the Beta SL Jacket – our lightest Beta – is carefully designed to deliver complete waterproof, windproof, breathable protection without sacrificing features or packability. Its next-generation GORETEX ePE membrane is light, thin, strong, and PFC free. C-KNIT backer technology improves comfort and breathability. The helmet-compatible StormHood protects without compromising vision, pit zippers ventilate, and a RECCO reflector can aid in search situations.

This product is free of intentionally added PFAS.

The new ePE membrane technology is lighter and thinner, but just as strong and durable as the materials we used before.   You may notice the face fabric “wetting out” slightly faster in products with ePE membranes, but rest assured this does not affect the waterproofing of the membrane itself. If you notice the fabric wetting out faster than you’d like, simply wash the jacket and dry it to remove the oil contamination and bring the DWR back to its full power.

X000008924.title: Sabre Bib Pant
X000008924.tagline: Durable, versatile GORE-TEX ePE freeride ski and snowboard bib with progressive design.

sections.heading: Sabre Bib Pant
sections.body:
Moving beyond boundaries, always seeking something new – if freeride’s your path, the Sabre’s your bib. Built to handle backcountry realities – and great for a day carving turns at the resort – it leverages durable, breathable 80D 3L ePE GORE-TEX to shut out sleet, snow, and wind. A warm backer adds light insulation. Thigh vents dump heat on the uptrack, articulation frees you to move, a RECCO® reflector’s embedded for added safety, and the full bib adds protection in deep powder.

What's been updated: Updated with a new durable, lightweight GORE-TEX ePE fabric that offers a reduced carbon footprint and has an 80D face fabric for enhanced durability without added weight.

This product is free of intentionally added PFAS.

The new ePE membrane technology is lighter and thinner, but just as strong and durable as the materials we used before.   You may notice the face fabric “wetting out” slightly faster in products with ePE membranes, but rest assured this does not affect the waterproofing of the membrane itself. If you notice the fabric wetting out faster than you’d like, simply wash the jacket and dry it to remove the oil contamination and bring the DWR back to its full power.

More styles include the Emblem Fleece Hoody, Emblem Fleece Full Zip Hoody and, Emblem Fleece Crew Neck Pullover.

X000010536.title: Sabre Jacket
X000010536.tagline: Durable, versatile freeride shell with stormproof GORE-TEX ePE protection.

sections.heading: Sabre Jacket
sections.body:
Freeride skiing and boarding is different – exhilarating, liberating, demanding. And it means respecting mountain realities. Made to meet the conditions the backcountry throws at you, the Sabre’s strong, breathable 80D 3L ePE GORE-TEX fabric shuts out wind and wet, driving snow. Its StormHood adjusts to maximize peripheral vision, and a RECCO reflector can help in search situations. And it’s made to move – articulated patterning and a fit that’s clean but not restrictive.

This product is free of intentionally added PFAS.

The new ePE membrane technology is lighter and thinner, but just as strong and durable as the materials we used before.   You may notice the face fabric “wetting out” slightly faster in products with ePE membranes, but rest assured this does not affect the waterproofing of the membrane itself. If you notice the fabric wetting out faster than you’d like, simply wash the jacket and dry it to remove the oil contamination and bring the DWR back to its full power.

sections.heading: Superlight jacket made from breathable fabric
sections.body: The Spere SL Jacket is a superlight design featuring a front zippered closure, shirt collar, structured chest pocket, and internal pocket. Crafted with Ondritex, a breathable, quick-dry textile that offers next-to-skin comfort and a natural hand feel.

sections.heading: Veilance
sections.body: A system of essential forms designed for navigating urban environments.

features.title: Material
features.body: Crafted in Onditrex™, a featherlight 70% nylon–30% abaca blend, offers next-to-skin comfort with a natural paper-like hand feel. At 99 gsm, it delivers UPF 50+ protection, moisture-wicking, and a dry feel for comfort in warm conditions.

X000009527.title: Serratus Pant Men's
X000009527.tagline: Hybrid softshell climbing pant. Breathable in key zones. Tough everywhere else.

sections.heading: Our most technical climb softshell pant
sections.body: Looking to shave weight without sacrificing durability and mobility, we used two kinds of fabric to make these our most technical softshell pant. A durable softshell fabric made with 88% recycled content reinforces areas where climbers rub, drag and brush up against rock the most. Everywhere else, a highly breathable, lightweight fabric helps keep them as light as possible.

features.title: FC0 durable water repellent
features.body: FC0 DWR (Durable Water Repellent) fabric treatment beads water for improved weather protection without potentially harmful PFAS substances.

features.title: Articulated construction
features.body: Articulation removes restriction, so we utilize complex patterning and seam placement to create three-dimensional designs that free you to move.

X000009495.title: Lana Merino Wool Crew Shirt SS
X000009495.tagline: Climb, run, and hike in this naturally light and odour-fighting Merino tee.

sections.heading: Lana Merino Wool Crew Shirt SS
sections.body:
This Merino-blend tee is an essential first layer for mountain runs, climbs, and approaches all year long. Naturally great at regulating temperature and anti-bacterial, Merino wool resists pilling and odours making it an excellent (less stinky) layer for multi-day pitches and hikes. Trust us, your tent-mates will thank you.

What's been updated: Updated Betaspun Merino wool combines nylon and TENCEL™ fibres for a lighter, softer, more durable yarn that regulates temperature and resists abrasion and pilling. We also gave it a new closer-to-body fit with a shorter body and straight hem.

features.title: Fit: Regular
features.body: Our classic fit is cut comfortably throughout the chest, waist, hip, and thigh. It allows freedom of movement, provides shape, and layers comfortably over or under our layers.

features.title: Technical features
features.body: Moisture-wicking · Breathable · Lightweight

features.title: Construction
features.body: Ultra fine Merino wool is known for soft comfort, natural temperature regulation and odour resistance · Betaspun technology combines fibres to create a light, soft, more durable yarn that regulates temperature and elevates resistance to abrasion and pilling · Plant-derived TENCEL™ fibres provide exceptional softness and breathability · Dynamically placed shoulder seams improve freedom of movement and are comfortable under pack straps · Nylon fibres add durability

features.title: Design & Fit
features.body: Regular fit provides freedom of movement

features.title: Patterning
features.body: Articulated patterning for unrestricted mobility

features.title: Sustainability
features.body: Merino yarns meet the RWS (Responsible Wool Standard) and are sourced from humanely raised, non-mulesed sheep · RWS (Responsible Wool Standard) - The wool in this product is 100% Responsible Wool Standard (RWS) certified by IDFL (No.TE-99950273) · PFAS (Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances) Compliant

features.title: Materials
features.body: Body: 17.5 microns Merino/Tencel/Recycled Nylon/Elastane circular knit single jersey, 150 gsm - 52% Wool, 28% Lyocell, 14% Nylon, 6% Elastane · Origin of Manufacture: VIETNAM · Origin of fabric: VIETNAM · Origin of dyeing: VIETNAM

features.title: Care
features.body: Machine wash gentle low · Tumble dry gentle low · Do not bleach · Wash dark colours separately · Do not dry clean · Iron low · Do not use fabric softener · Use wool detergent · Do not leave wet · Do not wring

features.title: Fit
features.body: Regular

X000008516.title: Kyanite Jacket
X000008516.tagline: Comfort in motion – stretch fleece jacket for low-to-medium-output mountain activities.

sections.heading: Kyanite Jacket
sections.body:
Ready for anything, the highly versatile Kyanite performs as a midlayer or standalone across a range of activities. Delivering warmth, mobility, and moisture management, Polartec Power Stretch Pro allows airflow for breathable comfort and has a durable nylon face for abrasion resistance. The fabric’s brushed interior adds softness, four-way stretch combines with articulated patterning for exceptional freedom of movement, and the streamlined fit layers easily under a shell.

What's been updated: Updated with a more streamlined fit for easier layering, an internal key pocket, and a design that facilitates repair.

features.title: Fit: Fitted
features.body: Our trimmer fit is patterned to stay close to the body through the chest, waist, hip, and thigh. Its low profile eliminates bulk, moves with the body, and fits comfortably over first layers or under outer layers.

features.title: Technical features
features.body: Durable · Versatile

features.title: Construction
features.body: Merrow and flatlock seam constructions reduce bulk and enhance comfort · Polartec® Power Stretch® Pro fleece combines a highly durable nylon face with a soft, comfortable, brushed polyester interior made with recycled content

features.title: Cuff & Sleeves configuration

features.title: Design & Fit
